record.field: Manual reception email to arrange registration and the first appointment.

div.p: Thank you for contacting our practice. Reception can help you confirm your contact details, complete the administrative registration, and agree an appointment.
Please use the document request or form shared by reception for any requested paperwork. Contact the practice if you need help with the registration or booking.

record.field: Manual follow-up on a patient quotation, with its standard portal link.

div.p: Reception is following up on cost proposal .
Please contact us if you would like to discuss the amounts, payment arrangements, or booking your next visit. We can arrange a conversation with the practitioner for questions about care.

div.p: Reception is checking in after your recent visit. Please contact us if you need help with your invoice, paperwork, or arranging the next appointment.
If you have a question about your care, contact the practice so we can put you in touch with the practitioner.
